title: Mixed Event — The BEST Summer Ever! — Episode4 More Freely

meta.Event Outline: The Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy first years arrive at the Seaside School. Finding themselves allocated to the same group for the school's annual presentation event, Honami, Saki, Emu, and Kohane put their showmanship skills to the test by performing a song from a musical.

rows.Line: Seaside School -  Day 2
Beach

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki, you're doing so well now!
Your kicking has improved so much since yesterday!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Really?!
All thanks to you, Ms. Hona♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Splishy-splash-splash!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, Emu, you're so fast! How is it that you're able to swim so fast...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You have to go all splishy-splash with your hands and go vrooom with your feet!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Um, okay...?
That sounds difficult...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Honami, there you are.
Is your group almost done with swimming practice?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, Shiho.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: The teachers want to talk to us about deciding who'll be presenting first and stuff.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I see.
We're just about to wrap up, so that should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, good. They need one person from each group to head over, it looks like.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I understand!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll go and talk to them, so I'll see you all during practice.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thanks, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, also.
There's something I want to do after this, so I'm gonna head back to our room once we're done here.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Sure!
See you later!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Bye...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (During practice... We decided to try to win, so I need to do the best I can...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But it's so hard to get into character and sing... How do I practice doing that?)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Huh...?!
Emu, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: There's something I wanted to ask you about singing practice...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wanna try coming up with how Amy and Dorothy feel during this scene?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, you mentioned that yesterday. Is this about singing in character?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! I thought that knowing how Amy and Dorothy felt during this song would make our BEST SUMMER sound even better!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Emu...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, I agree. I'm glad you asked too. I really want us to put on the best performance that we can...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Thanks, Kohane!
Lodge Classroom

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Let's begin our brainstorming session on how Amy and Dorothy feel during this scene!!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Should we start with how they both feel right as BEST SUMMER begins?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! BEST SUMMER is about how Amy and Dorothy want to make up and be friends again, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. But just before this song starts, Dorothy thinks that Amy doesn't want to be friends with her anymore.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! That's why it might be good for us to sing like there's a big emotional gap between us, like Dorothy and Amy!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A big emotional gap...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like how... Kohane, have you ever gotten into an argument with a friend before?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
An argument with a friend...?
When I was little, I got into a fight with a neighbor over the toys we were borrowing from each other.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And for the longest time, I couldn't find the courage to apologize to them...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, you can try singing while thinking about how you felt back then! That might be perfect for understanding how Amy feels!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
How I felt back then...?
Okay, I'll give it a try.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How does that sound...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That was sooo good!
I'm starting to get why Amy feels so far away!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Then Amy tells Dorothy that she wants to make up, and that makes Dorothy feel so happy...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I think this is how she would feel!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, that's Dorothy...
She's so happy after talking to Amy...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!
Alright, let's start again from just before the chorus!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I understand!
Lodge Gym

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Ugh... I thought we were going to decide an order by talking, not drawing straws...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah, I wasn't expecting that either.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: And we're going fourth. I don't feel great about our spot for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That means your group is somewhere in the middle, right, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We're at the very end. Our last shrine visit included, I really have no luck when it comes to these things...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's just a series of unfortunate coincidences.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But you said that your group is doing a skit in English. I can't wait to see it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd be more than happy to wait. But since Kiritani and Minori are in my group and working so hard, I'm in no position to slack off...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You're doing some kind of musical, right? Kohane's a part of a singing unit and Otori does shows all the time, so this should be easy for you guys.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
I wish I could say the same...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Is something wrong, Honami?
You seem a little down.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... We've actually been having a little trouble practicing our piece.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It didn't sound like a musical, huh?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes... We're all experienced singers and musicians, but something didn't feel quite right when we played together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu's the only one who's ever performed in a musical before, so our song and music seemed a little all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Emu mentioned how we need to understand how our characters felt more and play more freely, but it seems so hard when we actually try to do that...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Play more freely, huh...?
I don't think that's something anyone can do just by asking them to.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I know... But we decided to do a musical and it's an opportunity to work with people outside of our usual circles, so we all want to do the best we can.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Still, it is true that you can't just play more freely just by being asked to...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Let me ask you this, Honami. Do you know why you aren't able to do that yourself?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... It may be because I focus so much on maintaining a good rhythm. As a result, I'm not able to do something else in parallel...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Whenever we practice, Shiho, you're always telling me without fail to do just that. It seems like that will always take priority even if someone does tell me to try something different...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I see...
So me being so strict may be causing this.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It could also be that your mind has decided what drumming is supposed to sound like, you know?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh? But I tried playing more freely like Emu said...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yet you still maintain that a good rhythm is more important, no? That really might only apply to when we're playing as Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I think I understand...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: See?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For example, Leo/need and STANDOUT are similar types of bands, but don't sound the same at all...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: R-Right...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Based on who's playing for what band, the same music can have a completely different feel to it.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No one plays the guitar or keyboard or drums the same as someone else. Minor discrepancies add up into major differences.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So that means if the number of people in a band change, their sound will as well?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Exactly. I am always on you about maintaining a good rhythm but you're not playing with Leo/need right now, so I feel like you should distance yourself from what I've been saying in this case.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. My mind was so focused on playing the way I do whenever we practice, as Leo/need...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think that's your answer. Why don't you try focusing more on playing more freely like Otori said for your musical?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I guess I was overlooking something incredibly important until now.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I also think that you should play the way you like, Honami...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sure you'll find a way to make everything work.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you so much. I'll do what I can!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, there you are!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Shiho, Honami, would you like to join us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka even brought an inflatable penguin-shaped boat. You can try riding on it too, Shiho!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: M-Minori, please, lower your voice...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh no... This penguin's so cute...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I'm glad you like it so much.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori told me a little about how you like cute animals and such, Hinomori. Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, I mean... I...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. It's okay, Shiho, just tell her the truth.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
D-Don't say that.
Let's go. We're keeping them waiting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But thank you, Shiho. I finally understand.)
